description: Each command offered by the charter is reached from plain words of its triggers.

cases.prompt: sdd init: set up spec driven development in this repo
plan a feature: export the roadmap as a CSV file
analyze the spec and tell me what is wrong with it
spec status: which stories are done?
review implementation of the current story
fix this bug: ready lists a story whose dependency is still Todo
run a quality pass: check the product against its stories
sdd doctor: is the spec setup healthy?
clean up branches whose work has already landed
learn from the conversation: the developer wants every hand-over to name the branch it stands on
write a rule: never log the contents of environment variables
